Research_Gap: The available evidence does not establish how meristem signaling and stress-resilience processes interact over time.
Testable_Hypothesis: In Arabidopsis SAM, repeated stress with a recovery phase changes WUS/CLV3 expression domain or level differently from a single stress, and priming alters that difference.
Primary_Readout: pWUS/pCLV3 reporter signal and SAM recovery across time points
What_Would_Weaken_It: No reproducible difference in WUS/CLV3 or recovery between single and repeated stress
Evidence_Status: Supported gap; hypothesis not yet tested

Research_Gap: The available evidence does not establish how genome stability and chromatin maintenance are coordinated during long-term meristem maintenance.
Testable_Hypothesis: In Arabidopsis, loss of NHEJ function (e.g. Ku70 mutant) after DNA damage alters H3K27me3 at WUS compared with wild type.
Primary_Readout: H3K27me3 ChIP-qPCR at WUS; damage-marker clearance
What_Would_Weaken_It: H3K27me3 at WUS is unchanged between mutant and wild type after damage
Evidence_Status: Supported gap; hypothesis not yet tested

Research_Gap: The available evidence does not establish whether autophagy, proteostasis and redox control operate as a coordinated quality-control system.
Testable_Hypothesis: Impairing autophagy (atg mutant with a rescue line) before stress raises ROS and protein-aggregate load in the SAM and reduces recovery, compared with the rescued line.
Primary_Readout: Autophagic flux (not expression alone); ROS by type; NBR1 and chaperone readouts; SAM recovery
What_Would_Weaken_It: ROS and aggregates change but SAM recovery does not
Evidence_Status: Supported gap; hypothesis not yet tested

Research_Gap: The available evidence does not establish which relationships are causal versus merely associated.
Testable_Hypothesis: For each tested pair, a targeted perturbation of the upstream component changes the downstream readout, whereas an association-only link shows no change under perturbation.
Primary_Readout: Downstream readout after perturbation versus control
What_Would_Weaken_It: Downstream readout changes independently of the perturbation
Evidence_Status: Supported gap; hypothesis not yet tested

Research_Gap: The available evidence does not establish functional conservation or translational equivalence between plant mechanisms and human cellular aging mechanisms.
Testable_Hypothesis: A plant protein tested in a human cell line complements the loss of its human counterpart in a defined, measurable assay.
Primary_Readout: Complementation in a defined repair or flux assay
Evidence_Status: Supported gap; hypothesis only; outside core claims
